subject: U4: mcp-graph.js + hooks — drop the workspace pointer & cwd fallback, resolve via repoRoot
description:
Remove the single-pointer/cwd-as-workspace resolution at the client/hook edges, using lib/workspace-registry.repoRoot (merged on the feature branch). Independent files from U2/U5 — no overlap.

Changes:
1. mcp-graph.js:19 — remove the `readFileSync(~/.claude/orchestrator/workspace)` pointer read AND the `process.cwd()` fallback. New: `WS = process.env.ORCH_WORKSPACE || repoRoot(process.cwd())` (require ./lib/workspace-registry). If repoRoot is null, WS stays null.
2. mcp-graph.js:79 — guard the startup bind: `if (WS) await CALL('POST','/workspace',{path: WS})` (don't register a phantom workspace from a non-repo cwd). Confirm makeCall/extraToolsForClient tolerate a null WS (they only inject workspace when truthy — verify lib/mcp-core.js:57,59).
3. hooks/start-daemon.js:12,16,28 — replace `cwd → process.cwd()` with `repoRoot(input.cwd || process.cwd())`; skip POST /workspace if null. (Pure-Node hook can require('../lib/workspace-registry').)
4. hooks/start-daemon.sh — simplest correct fix: delegate to the .js (install wires .js hooks anyway) rather than re-implementing the walk-up in bash. If kept as shell, it must walk up for .graph/.git. Recommend delegation; note the choice.
5. hooks/statusline.js:8 — it calls getJson('/state', 400) with NO workspace, which 400s under P3 once the pointer is gone (latent bug surfaces here). Fix: resolve a workspace first (repoRoot(process.cwd())) and call /state?workspace=, or fall back gracefully if null. Self-contained — do NOT depend on U3.

CONFIRM (state in your summary): orch-gate.js and subagent-start.js need NO change — they are session/agent-scoped and never read the pointer. Do NOT touch daemon.js (U2), routes (U3), or CLI (U5).
